result.summary: Diagnosed ISS-0174 / GH-502. Confirmed the stale managed ArrayList API calls (init / deinit / appendSlice / toOwnedSlice) at src/lua/capabilities.zig:49-60 are unreached by any caller; confirmed src/lua_test_root.zig:95 only pins CapabilitySet as a bare type, so Zig's lazy semantic analysis never opens the function body and zig build test-lua reports green despite a hard compile error. The two existing doc-comment mentions of summary() in src/lua/host_context.zig:175 and :359 explicitly say 'do NOT call this from a longjmp context' (ISS-0169 ERR-2). Recommendation: MIGRATE summary() to the Zig 0.16 unmanaged ArrayList API (replace .init with .empty; pass allocator to every appendSlice / toOwnedSlice / deinit call) and ADD a real test in src/lua_test_root.zig that CALLS summary() against an empty CapabilitySet and against a multi-grant CapabilitySet, asserting on both outputs. RETAIN the function (do not delete) because writeGrants in src/lua/host_context.zig is the longjmp-safe twin and summary() is the legitimate utility for non-longjmp callers. The deliberate-mutation verification (ISS-0172 / GH-500 procedure) is preserved as MUST-3. SHOULD-1 extends the ISS-0173 / GH-501 zero-callers census to function-level granularity for src/lua/.

root_cause.mechanism: src/lua_test_root.zig:95 pins CapabilitySet with `_ = lua.capabilities.CapabilitySet;` — a bare TYPE reference. Zig resolves struct field types lazily and does not analyse a pub fn body that nothing reachable calls. Because CapabilitySet.summary() has zero real callers (census: 3 mentions of 'summary' across the entire repo, all of them either the definition itself or doc comments in src/lua/host_context.zig instructing callers NOT to use it), its body is never opened and the stale managed-API calls are never type-checked.

must_items: MUST-1: Migrate CapabilitySet.summary() to Zig 0.16 unmanaged ArrayList API (5 line-level edits in src/lua/capabilities.zig)

MUST-2: Replace the bare-type pin at src/lua_test_root.zig:95 with a REAL call to summary() inside a test block that exercises both branches (empty -> '(none)' ; multi-grant -> joined string with ', ' separator)
MUST-3: Deliberate-mutation verification — inject a statement error into summary() body, run zig build test-lua, confirm target goes red, revert mutation, confirm target returns to green
MUST-4: Record the decision (RETAIN and migrate) in this diagnosis YAML's fix_plan.decision field; cross-link from docs/anti-patterns.md under the ISS-0169 ERR-2 entry in DOC-UPDATER Step 7
should_items: SHOULD-1: Extend the ISS-0173 / GH-501 zero-callers census to public pub fn declarations under src/lua/ (function-level granularity), classifying each zero-caller as (a) candidate for deletion, (b) intentionally retained public API, or (c) ISS-0172 blind-spot class
SHOULD-2: Strengthen tools/lint_test_wiring.py to flag type-only pins (same item as ISS-0172 acceptance criterion #4; may be addressed jointly)
